$comment: Content, not code. Regenerate or hand-edit freely — the component renders whatever is here. States: yes | no | never | conditional | na. Optional `note` qualifies the state.

mechanisms.name: Client-Side Auto-Labeling
mechanisms.how: Real-time labeling as users create & edit documents or emails
notes: Exception: no action if file has sublabel from same parent when another sublabel from same parent matches

mechanisms.name: Service-Side Auto-Labeling Policies
mechanisms.how: Scans files at rest in SharePoint/OneDrive and emails in transit through Exchange
mechanisms.basedOn: SITs, Trainable Classifiers, sharing options, file type, size, name, contains text
notes: Can run in simulation mode first

doc.text: Configure auto-labeling policies for SharePoint, OneDrive, and Exchange

mechanisms.name: Default Label from Publishing Policy
mechanisms.location: Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Power BI & Fabric
mechanisms.how: Policy specifies default label for new/unlabeled content when created
notes: Different behavior for files/email vs Power BI

mechanisms.name: SharePoint Library Default Label
mechanisms.how: Location-based labeling applied to new/edited files in specific library
notes: Takes a few minutes for uploads

doc.text: Configure a default sensitivity label for a SharePoint document library

mechanisms.name: Label-Based Extension to Downloaded Documents
mechanisms.how: Document library label extends encryption to downloaded files via user-defined permissions

manual.note: if existing label does not encrypt

notes: Replaces labels that do not encrypt
Copilot can reference but not summarize files

mechanisms.name: Microsoft Syntex Document Understanding
mechanisms.how: AI models identify document types and apply configured labels

doc.text: Apply a sensitivity label to a model in Microsoft Syntex

mechanisms.name: Email Inheritance from Attachments
mechanisms.how: Email inherits highest priority label from labeled document attachments
notes: Policy setting: "Email inherits highest priority label from attachments"

doc.text: Configure label inheritance from email attachments

mechanisms.name: Email Thread Label Inheritance
mechanisms.how: Label on email automatically applied to subsequent replies in thread
notes: Appears in Activity Explorer as automatic labeling

mechanisms.name: Encryption-Based Label Matching
mechanisms.how: When document has admin-defined encryption without label, Office assigns matching label
mechanisms.basedOn: Matching encryption policy embedded in document
notes: Helps migrate from rights management templates

mechanisms.name: Teams Meetings — Inheritance from Meeting Files
mechanisms.how: Meeting inherits highest priority label from files shared in meeting (chat, Shared tab, Live share)

manual.note: unless manual label has lower priority

notes: Policy setting: Apply inheritance between Teams meetings and artifacts
Manually applied lower priority can be overridden
Notification sent to organizer before meeting starts

doc.text: Configure sensitivity labels for Teams meetings

mechanisms.name: Teams Container File Inheritance
mechanisms.how: Files inherit Team/channel label if unlabeled

mechanisms.name: Teams Meetings — Default Label from Policy
mechanisms.how: Default label applied to new meetings and calendar events
notes: Policy setting: Apply a default label to meetings and calendar events
Outlook: applied to new and updated unlabeled events
Teams: applied to new events only, not updated events
Independent from email default label setting

doc.text: Configure sensitivity labels for Teams meetings

mechanisms.name: Power BI — Creation Inheritance
mechanisms.how: New reports/dashboards automatically inherit label from parent semantic model/report
notes: Won't block creation if label can't be applied

mechanisms.name: Power BI — Downstream Inheritance
mechanisms.how: Label on semantic model/report propagates to downstream content
notes: Two modes: User Consent or Fully Automated
Never replaces with less restrictive label

mechanisms.name: Power BI — Data Source Inheritance
mechanisms.how: Semantic models inherit labels from labeled source data
notes: Sources: Azure Synapse, Azure SQL, Excel on OneDrive/SharePoint
Most restrictive chosen if multiple sources
Desktop: banner recommends more restrictive label

doc.text: Sensitivity label inheritance from data sources

mechanisms.name: Fabric / Power BI Domain-Level Default Label
mechanisms.how: Domain admin sets default label for workspaces in their domain
notes: Applied when items created/updated in domain workspaces
Follows same override logic as other auto-labeling

mechanisms.name: Information Protection Scanner
mechanisms.basedOn: SITs, Trainable Classifiers, or default labels
notes: Can apply default label to all files

doc.text: Learn about the information protection scanner

mechanisms.name: Defender for Cloud Apps
mechanisms.how: Session policies apply labels through cloud app monitoring
notes: Can detect and alert on label changes
Should be used as a secondary control — Purview is the primary solution for labeling

doc.text: Integrate with Microsoft Purview for information protection
